title: Newton's Laws of Motion: Force, Momentum, and Friction

questions.question: Why do passengers lurch forward when a moving bus brakes suddenly?
options: Their bodies keep moving due to inertia
Friction from the floor drags them ahead
questions.rationale: By the first law, the passengers' bodies continue their forward motion until a force (the seatbelt or seat) acts on them.

questions.question: In the lesson's worked example, what force accelerates a 2 kg block at 5 m/s²?
questions.rationale: From F = ma, the force is 2 kg × 5 m/s² = 10 N.

questions.question: One newton equals:
questions.rationale: The newton is the force that accelerates a 1 kg mass at 1 m/s², i.e. 1 kg·m/s².

questions.question: Why do action and reaction forces never cancel each other?
options: They act on two different bodies
They act in the same direction
questions.rationale: The third law pair acts on two different bodies, so no single body experiences both forces as a balance.

questions.question: Rocket propulsion, where hot gas is pushed down and the rocket is pushed up, illustrates which law?
questions.rationale: The rocket pushes gas downward and the gas pushes the rocket upward — an equal and opposite action-reaction pair.

questions.question: What is the momentum of a 2 kg trolley moving at 3 m/s?
questions.rationale: Momentum p = mv = 2 kg × 3 m/s = 6 kg·m/s.

questions.question: A 2 kg trolley at 3 m/s couples with a stationary 1 kg trolley. How fast does the joined pair move?
questions.rationale: Momentum 6 kg·m/s is conserved, so the combined 3 kg mass moves at 6 ÷ 3 = 2 m/s.

questions.question: Why does a cricketer draw the hands back while catching a fast ball?
options: To increase the force on the hands
To increase the collision time and reduce the force
questions.rationale: Stretching the collision time reduces the rate of change of momentum, so the impulse force on the hands is smaller.

questions.question: Mud flying off a spinning wheel moves tangentially because:
options: A centrifugal force pushes it outward
Once it leaves the wheel no inward force acts, so inertia carries it straight
The wheel keeps accelerating it outward
questions.rationale: The centripetal force acts only while the mud is in contact; after release, inertia carries it along the tangent.

questions.question: Which type of friction is usually the largest?
questions.rationale: The lesson's table lists static friction as the largest, with kinetic smaller and rolling the smallest of the three.
